events.title: Join the GRAVENTH Discord and help us shape the game
events.summary: GRAVENTH now has an official Discord server! We're building the game together with the people who play the demo, and every bit of feedback counts. events.title: The GRAVENTH demo is live, and we're improving it every day
events.summary: Thank you! In its first day the GRAVENTH demo reached hundreds of players, far more than we hoped. events.title: The GRAVENTH Demo Is Coming Soon — Testers Wanted!
events.summary: Hello, adventurers!We are happy to announce that the GRAVENTH demo will be available on Steam soon.Before its public release, we are looking for testers willing to explore the dungeon, fight its creatures, experiment with weapons and abilities, and help us find bugs or balance issues.Your feedback will help us improve combat, exploration, performance, and the overall experience.If you would like to become a tester, leave a comment or contact us. More details will be shared soon.Thank you for sup
